Load required libraries

```{r, load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(lubridate)    # For dates
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation
library(tidyr)        # pivot
library(ggplot2)      # Data visualization
library(data.table)   # Working with large files
library(xgboost)      # XGBoost model
library(caret)        # Preprocessing
library(caTools)
# library(cvms)
```

```{r, load-dataset}
dataset <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Define the start and end dates
start_date <- as.POSIXct("2018-12-01 00:00:00")
end_date <- as.POSIXct("2019-06-01 00:00:00")

# Filter the dataset for period no fires
dataset <- dataset[time_stamp >= start_date & time_stamp < end_date]

# Drop fire columns
dataset[, c("fire_day", "fire_distance", "fire_direction", "GIS_ACRES", "after_containment", "fire") := NULL]
```

```{r}
# Add engineered features
dataset[, `:=`(
  # Time features
  is_rush_hour = as.numeric(hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18)),
  is_weekend = as.numeric(dow %in% c(1,7)),
  season = fcase(
    month %in% c(12,1,2), 1,
    month %in% c(3,4,5), 2,
    month %in% c(6,7,8), 3,
    month %in% c(9,10,11), 4
  ),
  
  # Weather interactions
  temp_humid = pa_temp * pa_humidity,
  wind_speed_direction = wind_speed * cos(wind_direction),
  
  # Traffic-time interactions
  rush_congestion = mean_congestion_major * (hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18))
)]
```

```{r}
# Create two feature sets: with and without early lags
features_with_lags <- setdiff(names(dataset), 
                             c("time_stamp", "sensor_index", "pm2.5_alt"))

features_no_early_lags <- setdiff(features_with_lags, 
                                 c("pm2.5lag1", "pm2.5lag3"))
```


```{r}
# Sort and split data
dataset <- dataset[order(time_stamp)]
split_index <- floor(0.7 * nrow(dataset))
split_time <- dataset$time_stamp[split_index]
# Create training and test sets
train_data <- dataset[time_stamp <= split_time]
test_data <- dataset[time_stamp > split_time]
```

```{r}
# Function to prepare data and train model
train_xgb_model <- function(train_data, test_data, features, params) {
  # Prepare matrices
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_data[, ..features]), 
                        label = train_data$pm2.5_alt)
  dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_data[, ..features]), 
                       label = test_data$pm2.5_alt)
  
  # Train model with early stopping
  model <- xgb.train(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 5000,
    watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
    early_stopping_rounds = 50,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  # Return model and predictions
  preds <- predict(model, dtest)
  
  # Calculate metrics
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - test_data$pm2.5_alt)^2))
  mae <- mean(abs(preds - test_data$pm2.5_alt))
  r2 <- 1 - sum((test_data$pm2.5_alt - preds)^2) / 
    sum((test_data$pm2.5_alt - mean(test_data$pm2.5_alt))^2)
  
  list(
    model = model,
    predictions = preds,
    metrics = list(rmse = rmse, mae = mae, r2 = r2)
  )
}
```


```{r}
# XGBoost parameters
xgb_params <- list(
  booster = "gbtree",
  eta = 0.01,
  max_depth = 6,
  gamma = 1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric = "rmse"
)
```

```{}
# Train models with and without early lags
model_with_lags <- train_xgb_model(train_data, test_data, features_with_lags, xgb_params)
model_no_early_lags <- train_xgb_model(train_data, test_data, features_no_early_lags, xgb_params)
```

```{r}
# Load the model with early lags
model_with_lags <- readRDS(file.path("data", "models", "xgb_with_lags.rds"))

# Load the model without early lags
model_no_early_lags <- readRDS(file.path("data", "models", "xgb_no_early_lags.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Print results
cat("\nModel with all lags:\n")
print(model_with_lags$metrics)

# Model with all lags:
# $rmse
# [1] 0.4166484
# 
# $mae
# [1] 0.1053619
# 
# $r2
# [1] 0.6504693
```



```{r}
# Feature importance for both models
importance_with_lags <- xgb.importance(feature_names = features_with_lags, model = model_with_lags$model)
importance_with_lags
```

```{r}
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix = importance_with_lags)

```


```{r}
importance_no_early_lags <- xgb.importance(feature_names = features_no_early_lags,model = model_no_early_lags$model)
importance_no_early_lags
```


```{r}
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix = importance_no_early_lags)
```


```{r}
# Plot predictions vs actual for both models
plot_predictions <- function(actual, predicted, title) {
  data.frame(Actual = actual, Predicted = predicted) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```


```{r}
# x and y should have same scale
p1 <- plot_predictions(test_data$pm2.5_alt, model_with_lags$predictions, 
                      "Predictions with all lags")
p1
```


```{r}
p2 <- plot_predictions(test_data$pm2.5_alt, model_no_early_lags$predictions, 
                      "Predictions without early lags")
p2
```


```{r}
# Save models and results
saveRDS(model_with_lags, file.path("data", "models", "xgb_with_lags.rds"))
saveRDS(model_no_early_lags, file.path("data", "models", "xgb_no_early_lags.rds"))
```
